description: Search, read, and list public Grok Bot share links on Grokdex. No authentication.

tools.name: search_bots
tools.title: Search Grok Bots
tools.description: Search public Grok Bot listings on Grokdex by query, skill, or sort.

tools.name: get_bot
tools.title: Get a Grok Bot listing
tools.description: Fetch one Grokdex listing by slug.

tools.name: list_bot
tools.title: List a Grok Bot on Grokdex
tools.description: Publish or update a live public https://x.ai/bot/… share URL on the Grokdex board. Title and description come from x.ai. Re-pasting updates the listing. A conflicting X handle returns the existing listingUrl.

xHandle.description: Optional X username. Shown on the listing. Not a login and not verified.

tools.name: refresh_bot
tools.title: Refresh a Grokdex listing from x.ai
tools.description: Re-fetch a listed bot’s public x.ai share page and update identity on Grokdex. Does not change organic rank. Pass slug or shareUrl.
